rules.why: Full rent-control coverage depends on certificate-of-occupancy date and rent-stabilized status.
Just-cause protection is tied to fully or partially covered Rent Ordinance units, with only limited stated exemptions.
Deposit interest applies to fully or partially covered Rent Ordinance tenancies and gives no separate building-date cutoff.
The rule applies generally to Berkeley residential rental applications or existing tenancies when the listed fees are charged.
The fair-chance rule broadly covers rental housing providers, with exemptions for owner-occupied small properties and other special situations.
The new chapter creates a citywide prohibition on coordinated pricing algorithms for residential dwelling units.
